key_highlights: Nvidia Leadership Turmoil and Political Interference: Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO following direct intervention by Donald Trump, sparking fierce Congressional pushback, lingering DOJ probe questions, and extreme equity market volatility.

Global Trade Policy Escalation: The proposal of aggressive new tariffs, including up to 40% on China and broad duties on the European Union, intensifies stagflationary concerns and cross-border trade friction.

Severe Market Whipsawing: Global equity bourses experienced wild swings, exemplified by South Korea's KOSPI plunging 6% before attempting a stabilization rebound as AI sentiment vacillates between euphoria and skepticism.

Precious Metals Liquidation: Gold plummeted toward a 15-month low amid dollar strength and rate path repricing, triggering loan-to-value (LTV) margin breaches and auction notices among non-bank lenders.
Pan-European Financial Consolidation: UniCredit cleared the final regulatory hurdle to acquire Commerzbank, marking a landmark structural milestone for European banking integration.

sectors.implications: Heightened regulatory risk and multiple compression for mega-cap semiconductors despite long-term expansion into sovereign AI and orbital satellite data centers.

sectors.implications: Gold liquidation to 15-month lows strains collateralized lending; copper rebound indicates selective industrial resilience amid heavy macro volatility.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound, volatile conditions across global indices over the next 1-3 months. Tech valuation multiples face continued pressure from regulatory probes and tariff threats, while Asian bourses rely on stabilization funds.
market_outlook.long_term: Bifurcated 6-12 month market structure favoring companies embedded in regionalized supply chains, state-backed technological sovereignty initiatives, and well-capitalized consolidating financial institutions.
